title: Phage label released from infected bacteria by the blender, Hershey and Chase 1952
description: Bar chart of the percentage of each radioactive label found in the fluid after infected E. coli were spun down, from Table V of Hershey and Chase (1952), at 0.6 phage per bacterium. Sulfur-35, in the protein coat: 16 percent without the blender, 81 percent after 2.5 minutes in it. Phosphorus-32, in the DNA: 10 percent without the blender, 21 percent after it.
heading: LABEL RELEASED FROM THE CELLS · PERCENT · TABLE V

source.container: Hershey and Chase, Journal of General Physiology 36 (1952), Table V
